data.one_liner: Widget that renders customizable 3D rain effect
data.what_it_does: ParallaxRain draws a 3D rain animation that can be wrapped around any child widget. It supports multiple colors, speeds, layers, trails and can be positioned behind or in front of the child.
use_when: Add a dynamic rain background to a UI
Need customizable drop colors and speeds
Want a parallax effect without external dependencies
avoid_when: Running on very low‑end devices where heavy animation hurts performance
Using it in a non‑Flutter environment
strengths: Highly customizable drop colors, speeds, layers and trails
Smooth animation with frame‑rate independent speed
weaknesses: Only available for Flutter (no native platform APIs)
Animation may be heavy on low‑end devices
data.minimal_example:
ParallaxRain(
  dropColors: const [Colors.red, Colors.green, Colors.blue],
  trail: true,
  child: const Text('Rainy UI'),
)
